verdict.rationale: React is an open-source, MIT-licensed client-side/server library distributed via npm and GitHub, so it runs entirely within the consumer's own infrastructure by default — there is no vendor-hosted SaaS alternative to opt out of; evidence shows install via build tools, embedding in existing pages, and full source availability. Missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting/production-deployment guide or independent case studies of large-scale self-hosted deployments beyond the general install docs.
